supporting_observations.claim: WS-BCARTER-01 made repeated proxy HTTPS CONNECT requests to update.chartmate-imaging.net from 13:38 through 14:08 UTC, at intervals of roughly five minutes. Most shown requests returned 200; the 13:43 and 13:52 requests returned 407 and 502, respectively.

The recurring connections are linked in endpoint network events to PID 3416, identified as cmupdate.exe running as ben.carter from the user's AppData\Local\ChartMate directory; it was launched shortly before the first observed connection.

The observed destination and executable path differ from the ChartMate inventory entries: the logs show update.chartmate-imaging.net and an AppData\Local executable, while the inventory lists update.chartmate-imaging.com and C:\Program Files\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe.

A file-creation event for the running cmupdate.exe path was logged shortly after its first observed connection; the record alone does not establish whether this was a legitimate updater replacement or suspicious modification.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not establish the executable's signature, hash, provenance, or whether its contents changed in the file-creation event.

Although Zeek SSL coverage is reported as available, no relevant Zeek SSL details are included in the supplied records; the proxy records show requested CONNECT destinations, not the remote certificate or decrypted HTTPS content.
The available proxy and endpoint records show connection attempts and outcomes but do not establish what data, if any, was exchanged inside successful HTTPS tunnels.
claims_not_established: Whether the AppData copy of cmupdate.exe is a legitimate ChartMate updater or an impersonating/replaced executable.
Whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is an authorized ChartMate endpoint or is related to the inventory-listed .com domain.
Whether the successful HTTPS tunnels transferred an update, other content, or data from the workstation.
Whether the observed file-creation event represents a normal self-update.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire the cmupdate.exe file and verify its digital signature, hash, version, origin, and relevant file-system history; compare it with the approved ChartMate installation.
Validate ownership and authorization of update.chartmate-imaging.net with the ChartMate vendor, and obtain DNS, TLS SNI/certificate, and destination reputation details for the observed connections.
Review ChartMate updater configuration and update logs, plus proxy tunnel metadata or available HTTPS inspection evidence, to determine what the successful sessions did.
unrelated_findings: At 13:54:48 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 connected to FILE-HD-01 over SMB and FILE-HD-01 recorded an ANONYMOUS LOGON. This is separate from the alerted HTTPS activity and merits separate review. (T015-00253, T015-00257)
